en: The postcard displays a picturesque garden scene with tall willow trees and a notable round classical pavilion (temple) in the background, surrounded by white benches and manicured hedges. The upper left of the image reads 'Bad Pyrmont. Partie beim Erdbeertempel.' The reverse side features handwritten German text, a postmark, a Deutsche Reich postage stamp, and a logo that states 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
